title: Predictors of COVID-19 Infection and Disease Progression
brief_summary: Clinical Picture: Symptomatic COVID-19 presents with a recognizable clinical syndrome that is predictable prior to testing. Clinical judgement remains important, particularly when interpreting negative test results; 2. Biomarkers Associated with COVID-19 Patients: The most common laboratory features reported in patients with COVID-19
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All cases positive COVID 19 RT PCR

* cases with chronic diseases ( cancers, diabetes Liver or Kidney )
